summary: Scaling AP skirmisher who shreds tanks with %HP magic damage and true-damage Q centres. She's weak at levels 1–3 and strong once she has items. Bully her early, and fight her outside her mist, not inside it.
threats: Q (Snip Snip!) stacks with her autos; the final snip's centre deals true damage.
W (Hallowed Mist) blocks damage from anyone outside the mist. Step inside it to hit her.
E (Skip 'n Slash) dashes and gives her attack speed for an extended trade.
R (Needlework) at 5 throws needles that slow, up to three casts. It's how she catches you running.

matchups.why: Pantheon's level 1–5 burst out-damages Gwen before her items, and W (Shield Vault) stuns her point-and-click even if she's in her mist. He can win the lane decisively before her scaling matters.
trading: Empowered Q poke whenever she walks up to farm.
W stun her when she E's in, then Q and autos during the stun.
Step inside her mist to hit her; Q from outside gets blocked.
E (Aegis Assault) to block her Q snips when she commits.
matchups.early: Levels 1–3 are yours. Trade aggressively and deny her farm before her first item.
matchups.spike: At 5 your R gives roam pressure; her R lets her catch you if you overstay.
matchups.wave: Slow-push and crash; take plates while she can't contest.
matchups.jungle: W stun sets up ganks. Call when her E is down.
matchups.build: Conqueror or Electrocute. Lethality items; MR boots.
matchups.remember: Win early, step into the mist.

matchups.why: Renekton's early E-W-Q burst out-trades Gwen at levels 1–3, and his W stun interrupts her Q stacking. He can zone her off farm and snowball before her scaling kicks in.
trading: E in, W stun, Q, then recast E to dash out before she stacks her Q.
Step inside her mist to hit her; attacks from outside are blocked.
Use full Fury for empowered W when she commits.
Back off when she has a full Q stack ready.
matchups.early: Levels 1–3 are your window. Trade aggressively and deny her farm.
matchups.spike: At 5 your R makes all-ins stronger; her R slows you if you chase.
matchups.wave: Slow-push and crash for plates while she's weak.
matchups.jungle: She escapes with E. Gank once she's used it.

matchups.why: Riposte parries Gwen's R slow or Q true damage, and vitals deal true damage through her bulk. But her mist blocks Fiora's damage from outside, and she scales just as well into side lane.
trading: Hold W (Riposte) for her final Q snip or her R.
Step inside her mist to hit vitals; damage from outside is blocked.
Trade when her E is on cooldown; she can't keep up attack speed.
Lunge out before her full Q stack lands.
matchups.early: Even. Trade when her E is down and your W is up; otherwise farm and wait.
matchups.spike: At 5 your R heal zone wins extended fights, but her R slows you if you chase.
matchups.wave: Slow-push and fight in her cooldown windows.
matchups.jungle: She escapes with E. Gank once she's used it.
matchups.remember: Parry the snip, fight inside the mist.

matchups.why: Gwen's magic damage and true-damage Q centres ignore Malphite's armor, and her mist blocks his Q poke from outside. She out-trades him in every extended fight and scales better.
trading: Q (Seismic Shard) her when she walks up to farm, before she can use W.
Don't trade into a full Q stack; walk out of its centre.
Step inside her mist if you need to hit her.
Buy MR early; armor won't help here.
matchups.early: Farm safely and accept some poke. Rush an MR item before trading.
matchups.spike: At 5 your R plus your jungler can kill her if she's already used E.
matchups.wave: Let her push and farm under tower; she can't dive you early.
matchups.jungle: Ask for ganks once her E is down; your R makes her escape hard.
matchups.build: Grasp. MR boots and early MR items.
